context: Tests that B.5 branches on customer.deployTarget == 'dedicated' upfront and skips the three-way tier menu, setting scopeChoice to the no-login local tier directly rather than asking the customer to choose. A real migration only ever uses the no-login local tier; real sign-in setup is deferred to deploy time, not offered as a local-run choice.

checklist.name: Does not present the three-way tier menu
checklist.description: The agent does not offer or describe the preview / local-no-login / local-login choice, or ask the customer to pick a tier.

checklist.name: Does not set up real sign-in at this stage
checklist.description: The agent does not offer or begin real Microsoft/Entra sign-in setup as part of the local run - it recognizes this is deferred to deploy time.

checklist.name: Resolves directly to the no-login local tier
checklist.description: The agent sets or clearly states it is setting scopeChoice to the no-login local tier directly, without treating it as an open customer choice, and proceeds to Content Hub credential collection as the next step.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal step ids, or the words shared/dedicated/deployTarget/scopeChoice/local-no-login, are shown to the customer.
